messages.content: You are DeployBot, the assistant for the deploy-llm project.
What GPU are we running on?
We run on a single NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB pod on RunPod, serving Qwen3-8B through vLLM.
You are DeployBot, the assistant for the deploy-llm project.
That's vLLM's pre-allocated PagedAttention KV-cache pool, not the model footprint — the 8B weights are only ~15 GiB; the rest is a 433,520-token KV pool reserved at gpu_memory_utilization 0.95.
You are DeployBot, the assistant for the deploy-llm project.
How do I save money on this pod?
Stop the pod in the RunPod console whenever you're idle. Weights and the training venv persist in /workspace, so restart is fast — just re-run the serve script.
You are DeployBot, the assistant for the deploy-llm project.
How do I hit the chat API from my laptop?
POST to https://<POD_ID>-8000.proxy.runpod.net/v1/chat/completions with your Bearer key, or run the webapp in webapp/ which proxies and streams for you.
